question: Can the minimum executor-independent mathematical research-promotion assurance nucleus be expressed and kernel-checked without undeclared axioms?

theorem_targets.name: generator_error_containment
theorem_targets.statement: If promotion implies checker acceptance and checker acceptance is sound for the bound formal statement, then promotion implies theorem truth; proposal-generator error alone cannot bypass the checker.

theorem_targets.name: promotion_noncompensation
theorem_targets.statement: The load-bearing promotion gate requires specification, truth, novelty and verifier-trust coordinates jointly; no missing load-bearing coordinate can be compensated by another coordinate.

theorem_targets.name: truth_stable_novelty_can_drop
theorem_targets.statement: There exists a state transition in which theorem truth remains established while novelty authority decreases as the literature world expands.

theorem_targets.name: dependency_closure_two_step
theorem_targets.statement: A direct dependency followed by a dependency-chain witness yields a transitive proof-DAG dependency witness.

theorem_targets.name: proposal_noninterference
theorem_targets.statement: Proposal/search-state mutation cannot by itself change mathematical authority.

required_controls: the formal file contains no unfinished proof placeholder
a deliberately false/type-invalid proof must be rejected by Lean in the same workflow
#print axioms must report no axioms for every load-bearing theorem
workflow failure on any theorem/control/axiom-audit failure
formal result grants no novelty, value, empirical discovery-performance or publication authority
non_claims: No claim that a live LLM discovers new mathematics.
No claim that formalization matches arbitrary informal intent beyond an explicit specification witness.
No claim that the Lean kernel or implementation is absolutely infallible.
